creative_deliverable.content:
SCENE START

INT. OFFICE MEETING ROOM - CONTINUOUS

The meeting has just ended. Only LIN YAN and CHEN MO remain. Lin Yan glances at the door, then turns to Chen Mo, who is gathering his notebook and sliding his laptop into his bag.

LIN YAN
Before you go—there's a change for tomorrow. The morning presentation still has to happen, but the person who was going to give it can't be there.

Chen Mo pauses, one hand on the bag strap.

CHEN MO
What happened?

LIN YAN
I couldn't get into details. I was only told they're unavailable.

Chen Mo looks at her, waiting.

LIN YAN
I need someone to take it over. You know the material better than almost anyone in the room today.

Chen Mo resumes packing, slower this time.

CHEN MO
That's very short notice.

LIN YAN
It is. I know you had plans to leave, but we need a decision before tonight.

Chen Mo zips the bag halfway, then stops.

CHEN MO
If I do this, I'm not walking in cold. I'll need all existing materials sent to me tonight—everything they've already prepared.

LIN YAN
I can send you what we have by the end of the evening.

Chen Mo pulls the zipper to the end and picks up the bag.

CHEN MO
Then I'll take it, for now. But it's conditional on receiving the materials tonight. If anything's missing, we'll need another plan.

Lin Yan nods.

LIN YAN
Understood. I'll get them to you.

Chen Mo leaves. Lin Yan remains, looking at the door for a moment before gathering her own things.

SCENE END

control_data.scene_function: Negotiate who covers tomorrow morning's presentation under uncertainty and time pressure.
control_data.objectives: Lin Yan: obtain a confirmed presenter. Chen Mo: avoid unmanaged responsibility unless conditions are clear.
control_data.resistance: Chen Mo's need for materials and concern about unreasonable pressure vs. Lin Yan's urgency and incomplete information.
control_data.before_state: Meeting ended; Lin Yan uncertain about staffing; Chen Mo preparing to leave.
control_data.turn: Lin Yan asks; Chen Mo initially resists, then conditionally accepts with a material and time requirement.
control_data.state_after: Chen Mo has conditionally accepted; Lin Yan must send all existing materials tonight.
control_data.entry_rationale: Start immediately after meeting ends to preserve time pressure and private setting; no preamble required because the change is already urgent.
control_data.exit_rationale: End after Chen Mo's conditional acceptance and exit; Lin Yan's lingering reaction shows the unresolved logistics without implying a new scene event.
